# Commodity forward curve (`commodity-curve` v1)

Futures settlement prices by delivery month.

**Group:** Market data · **Mnemonic:** `CMDC` · **Identifiers:** `CMDC-…` in `curveId`

Open one with `CMDC <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: commodity-curve
version: 1
description: Futures settlement prices by delivery month.
match: { kind: commodity-curve, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Market data · Commodity forward curve, id: $.curveId }
strip:
  - { label: Commodity, bind: $.commodity }
  - { label: Front, bind: $.front, fmt: price2, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Shape, bind: $.shape }
  - { label: "M1–M12", bind: $.roll, fmt: price2, tone: sign }
panels:
  - id: curve
    kind: line
    title: Forward curve
    key: F2
    rows: $.points
    x: month
    y: price
    fmt: price2
  - id: points
    kind: table
    title: Settlements
    rows: $.points
    columns:
      - { label: Month, bind: "@.month" }
      - { label: Price, bind: "@.price", fmt: price2 }
      - { label: OI, bind: "@.openInterest", fmt: amount0 }
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.commodityRef, 'commodity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
